primary_endpoint: Change in blood glucose in healthy controls and fructose-induced change in LDL, from baseline to approximately 1 hour after IV fructose.
efficacy_outcome: Blood glucose change in healthy controls: 6.26 mg/dL (p=0.01). LDL changes reported for patients with NAFLD: 5.47 and -1.13 mg/dL (p=0.006).
safety_signal: No serious adverse events or deaths: 0/81 patients with NAFLD and 0/37 healthy controls.
